svg.title: A2. Sign-in, Ordering and Access Control

g.text: A2. Sign-in, Ordering and Access Control
Sign in: one form for all roles
Look up account; verify BCrypt hash in backend
Place an order: backend owns price and identity
Body: coffeeId and quantity, not price or customerId
Forward session cookie and CSRF header
Read available coffee and current unit price
Calculate total = stored unit price x quantity
Save account ownership, coffee name/price snapshot,
Personal list: filter by principal's account ID
Catalog POST / PUT / DELETE also require ADMIN.
Browser route guards are UX only; the API enforces authorization.
Blue: user interface and delivery | Green: trusted backend | Amber: data
Numbered messages show the normal local-account flow.
Keycloak is not integrated yet. Proxy return hops are condensed for readability.
